name: Contact form
description: A contact form with name, e-mail, subject, message and privacy consent, placed with the [contact] shortcode or a widget. Messages are e-mailed to the site administrator or a configured address, with Reply-To set to the visitor.
author: sap13ns

widgets.title: Contact form
widgets.description: The contact form, with the intro text and the privacy link from the plugin settings.

settings.label: Send messages to
settings.help: Empty sends them to the site administrator.

settings.label: Subject prefix
settings.help: Starts the subject of every e-mail, so you can filter them.

settings.label: Privacy policy
settings.help: Link shown above the form: https://…, http://… or a site path such as /privacy. The consent checkbox refers to it.

settings.label: Privacy policy (Spanish pages)
settings.help: For example /es/privacidad. Empty uses the link above.

settings.label: Text above the form
settings.help: Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs. Empty shows none.

settings.label: Message after sending
settings.help: {name} and {email} are replaced. Empty uses "Thanks, {name}! Your message was sent. We will reply to {email}." (in Spanish on Spanish pages).

settings.label: Most links in a message
settings.help: Messages with more links are refused. 0 allows none.

label.en: I have read and accept the privacy policy
label.es: He leído y acepto la política de privacidad
